title: Google Search
task: Find citable web results for an agent
description: Search Google for current web results, titles, snippets and source URLs. Uses FlashData credits. Do not repeat a query after an unknown outcome; check Jobs first.
prompt: Find three current sources about LangGraph durable execution using Google Search. Cite their URLs and distinguish snippets from full-page evidence.

title: Google News
task: Build a topic briefing with publisher links
description: Search Google News by topic, country, language and time filter. Returns headlines, links, publishers and available dates/snippets, not article full text. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Search Google News for semiconductor manufacturing in the past day. Produce a short briefing with publisher names and article links; do not invent article details.

title: Google Images
task: Find image candidates with source pages
description: Search Google Images for image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions and source pages. Does not download images or grant reuse rights. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Find five solar panel installation diagrams with Google Images. List source pages and any available dimensions, without claiming reuse rights.

title: Google Shopping
description: Search Google Shopping for products, merchants and available price/rating fields. A search snapshot does not guarantee stock or checkout price. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Compare five USB-C docking station listings from Google Shopping. Show the displayed price and merchant link, and mark missing values rather than estimating.

title: Google Video Search
description: Search Google Videos across websites for video titles, links and available durations and source information. Different from YouTube-only search. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Use Google Video Search to find battery recycling demonstrations across websites. Return links with the available duration and hosting site.

title: Google Places
description: Search Google Places for local businesses, addresses, coordinates and available ratings or contact details. Phone numbers may be absent. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Find five coffee shops in Cambridge, UK using Google Places. Show reported addresses and websites, and mark missing fields.

title: YouTube Search
description: Find YouTube videos by search query. Returns video IDs and available video metadata. Uses FlashData credits. Do not repeat a query after an unknown outcome; check Jobs first.
prompt: Find five YouTube tutorials about LangGraph with subtitles. List video IDs and channels, and explain that transcript language availability still needs checking.

title: YouTube Extended Search
task: Collect a larger video discovery set
description: Search YouTube with an extended limit of up to 700 requested results and optional filters. Actual count may be lower. Uses a separate FlashData source and credit rate.
prompt: Use YouTube Extended Search to collect up to 50 urban farming videos from this month, ordered by view count. Report the actual returned count.

title: YouTube Video Metadata
task: Inspect a video before deeper processing
description: Get YouTube video metadata by ID or URL, with optional chapters and format metadata. Uses FlashData credits. Do not repeat a query after an unknown outcome; check Jobs first.
prompt: Inspect the metadata and available chapters for the supplied YouTube video. List caption languages if present and avoid inventing missing chapters.

title: YouTube Transcript
description: Get a YouTube transcript with timestamped segments by video ID or URL. Specify language and auto=true for automatic captions or auto=false for manual captions. No implicit fallback. Uses FlashData credits. Do not repeat a query after an unknown outcome; check Jobs first.
prompt: Read the automatic English transcript of the supplied video. Summarize its main points with segment timestamps; stop if the requested track is unavailable.

title: YouTube Captions
description: Retrieve YouTube captions with timestamped segments. Defaults to manual uploader captions (auto=false), language en. No transcription, translation or automatic fallback. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Retrieve the uploader-provided English captions for the supplied YouTube video. Report timestamped text and do not fall back to automatic captions.

title: YouTube License Metadata
description: Inspect YouTube license metadata for a Creative Commons label. The trainability source does not read creator training settings or grant training permission. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Inspect the license metadata for the supplied video. Explain only whether a Creative Commons label was detected; do not claim training permission.

title: YouTube Channel Data
task: Snapshot a channel and recent uploads
description: Get YouTube channel data by handle and up to 100 requested recent videos. Statistics and some fields may be unavailable. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Snapshot @jawed with up to five recent videos. Distinguish channel statistics from the returned sample and mark unavailable counts.

title: YouTube Autocomplete
description: Get YouTube autocomplete suggestions for a query prefix, language and region. Returns phrases, not videos or search-volume estimates. Uses FlashData credits.
prompt: Get YouTube autocomplete suggestions for python async in English and the US region. Present the phrases without assigning search-volume estimates.

title: YouTube Download
task: Deliver video or audio to customer storage
description: Submit a paid YouTube video/audio download to configured customer cloud storage. Returns an asynchronous job ID, not a completed file. Save the ID and use download job readers; never resubmit just because it is pending. Billed on delivered bytes.
prompt: For the authorized video, submit one ten-second MP3 clip to the configured destination. Save the job ID; use only the readers while it is pending, and never submit it again merely to check progress.
